customer_message: My Larkfield thermostat screen is blank. Is it broken?
expected_answer: A blank screen usually means no power. First, check that the circuit breaker for your HVAC system is on. Second, remove the thermostat from its base and confirm the C wire is connected to the C terminal; without it the unit cannot charge. Third, reattach the thermostat and wait 10 minutes for the internal battery to charge. If the screen stays blank after that, reply with a photo of the wiring and we will arrange a warranty replacement.

customer_message: The Larkfield app says my hub firmware update failed and now none of my devices respond.
expected_answer: First, leave the hub powered on and connected for 15 minutes; it retries the update automatically. Second, if the light is still red, unplug the hub for 30 seconds and plug it back in to retry. Third, in the app open the hub, choose Check for updates, and install any pending version. Do not factory reset the hub, because that removes every paired device and they would all need re-pairing.

customer_message: I started a free trial of Plus. When do I have to cancel to avoid being charged?

customer_message: I was charged for Plus but I cancelled last month. Why?

I can see the cancellation request on file; if the charge posted after the period ended, reply with the charge date and we will refund it. You will receive a confirmation email when the plan is fully closed.
